gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare commencing on the south-eastern side of Dock Street opposite Wu Hu Street, running in a south-easterly direction for about 177 m. and terminating in front of K.M.L. 27 (Hong Kong & Whampoa Docks) as shown coloured yellow on drawing No. KH 1910/1.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道起點位於船澳街之東南面與蕪湖街相對之處。向東南伸展而終於九龍第二十七號海段（香港黃埔船塢）之前，全長約一百七十七公尺，其位置在 KH 1910/1 號圖則上用黃色標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare commencing on the north-eastern side of Tak Man Street referred to above, running in a north-easterly direction for about 55 m., then turning south-easterly for a distance of about 130 m. and terminating in front of K.M.L. 27 (Hong Kong & Whampoa Docks) as shown coloured red on drawing No. KH 1910/1.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道起點位於上述德民街之東北面，初向東北伸展，約五十五公尺後轉向東南伸展約一百三十公尺之距離，其終點位於九龍第二十七號海段（香港黃埔船塢）之前。位置在 KH 1910/1 號圖則上用紅色標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare about 55 m. long as shown coloured blue on drawing No. KH 1910/1 joining Man Tai Street and Tak Man Street, referred to above, at right angle.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道以垂直角度連接上述之德民街及民泰街，全長約五十五公尺，位置在 KH 1910/1 號圖則上之藍色標明。
